conventions.A: uncapped unsigned geometric cycle occurrences after the fixed primal forest, reduced mod2
conventions.B: source cap incidence mod2, retaining both ends of loops before reduction
conventions.D: all capped-total>2 rows, all empty rows, and all single-column rows with count>=2
conventions.H: honest one-unit or two-distinct-unit occurrence rows outside D, with a formal ground vertex
conventions.boundary_root: formal scheduling ground only; no topological boundary identification
conventions.homology: beta2 = m-q-rank(A), with independently verified rank(B)=q
conventions.claim: if D is G-forest then every dual tree containing D has the same short-H residual nullity beta2
conventions.scope: native authenticated geometric cores; arbitrary graph pairs need not satisfy the chain identity
